subject.title: fix(ui): keep microphone input settings usable on narrow screens

question: Is the screenshot and deterministic-browser proof enough to land this settings-owned microphone selector, or should maintainers require physical microphone/native permission-dialog proof first?
rationale: The patch changes a user-visible microphone permission and device-selection workflow; the source and tests are strong, but the PR body explicitly leaves physical hardware and native permission-dialog proof untested.

options.title: Land with existing proof
options.body: Accept the mocked browser coverage plus inspected desktop/mobile screenshots as sufficient for this responsive UI follow-up, then merge after current-head CI and normal maintainer review.

options.title: Request hardware proof
options.body: Ask for a short redacted run with a physical microphone and browser permission dialog before merging, trading speed for higher end-to-end confidence.

options.title: Pause the follow-up
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want the microphone selector to remain in the composer caret until a broader Talk control design is revisited.

recommendation.title: Land with existing proof
recommendation.body: Accept the mocked browser coverage plus inspected desktop/mobile screenshots as sufficient for this responsive UI follow-up, then merge after current-head CI and normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the original microphone-selector issue and merged the predecessor implementation that this PR revises.
